overrides.replacement_claim: The public performance CLI lacks compatibility tests for stable output, stream separation, and semantic exit mappings.
overrides.reason: Both theories describe the same coverage defect. Product tests and the conformance review establish the static coverage gap. New executable evidence covers dry-run JSON, status text, stream separation, and operational failure, but representative semantic exit branches remain unexecuted.
Production serve and TUI paths validate performance settings before constructing the shared runner, so the alleged production bypass is absent.

overrides.replacement_claim: Performance CLI output failures are silently discarded because JSON encoding and text rendering write errors are ignored.
overrides.reason: Executable tests using a failing stdout writer observed missing output errors in JSON and text modes.
The CLI presents fewer fields than browser and TUI surfaces, but the governed requirement permits presentation differences and does not require every surface to render every DTO field.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance evidence API fails when its advertised URL omits the limit parameter because zero reaches pagination and is rejected.
overrides.reason: Executable HTTP evidence observed HTTP 500 when limit was omitted and success with limit=1.
Validation matches the documented rule that workspace and environment values may only lower built-in defaults; hard maxima are separate immutable ceilings.

overrides.replacement_claim: Persisted repair reverification validation accepts a passing performance record with no target results.
overrides.reason: Executable evidence demonstrated acceptance of a passing record with zero target results.

overrides.replacement_claim: Repair performance reverification associates baselines by slice position rather than target identity.
overrides.reason: Executable two-target evidence reordered digest-valid baselines and observed each target receiving the other target's median.

overrides.replacement_claim: A met report-only performance target produces a flow summary rejected as invalid because outcome counts are bounded by required-target count only.
overrides.reason: Executable package-local evidence produced Required=0, Reports=1, Met=1 and observed validation reject the summary.

overrides.replacement_claim: Optimization rejection paths ignore isolation cleanup failures and can continue without preserving cleanup uncertainty.
overrides.reason: The implementation ignores cleanup results before continuing. Existing investigator tests inspect source or simulate another loop rather than executing the optimization path, so promotion evidence remains insufficient.

overrides.replacement_claim: Failed candidate or regression measurements omit executed commands from durable counters, permitting admission against an understated command total.
overrides.reason: Executable evidence observed 56 process calls against a command limit of 40 while durable command accounting remained 8.

overrides.replacement_claim: The JSON performance output parser accepts malformed trailing bytes after a valid envelope.
overrides.reason: Executable parser evidence returned the expected value without error for a valid envelope followed by a malformed opening brace.
The documentation distinguishes lower-only configurable values from immutable product ceilings, so the validator matches the documented configurable range.

overrides.replacement_claim: The project performance-policy parser accepts case-variant mode values despite the exact lowercase contract.
overrides.reason: Executable evidence observed uppercase and mixed-case mode values accepted without findings.

issues.claim: Performance CLI output failures are silently discarded because JSON encoding and text rendering write errors are ignored.
issues.title: Performance CLI drops stdout failures
issues.reason: A failed output write can leave the command reporting success or only its underlying operation error.

issues.claim: The JSON performance output parser accepts malformed trailing bytes after a valid envelope.
issues.title: Performance JSON parser accepts malformed suffixes
issues.reason: A syntax error from the trailing decode is accepted instead of requiring EOF.

issues.claim: The project performance-policy parser accepts case-variant mode values despite the exact lowercase contract.
issues.title: Performance policy mode parsing is not exact
issues.reason: Lowercasing before validation turns malformed case variants into valid activation values.

issues.claim: Optimization rejection paths ignore isolation cleanup failures and can continue without preserving cleanup uncertainty.
issues.title: Optimization continues after uncertain isolation cleanup
issues.reason: Ignored cleanup failures can permit subsequent work despite an unproved disposable-workspace boundary.

issues.claim: The public performance CLI lacks compatibility tests for stable output, stream separation, and semantic exit mappings.
issues.title: Performance CLI compatibility coverage is incomplete
issues.reason: Product tests do not cover the complete stable presentation and semantic exit contract.

issues.claim: Failed candidate or regression measurements omit executed commands from durable counters, permitting admission against an understated command total.
issues.title: Failed measurements evade the command budget
issues.reason: Executable evidence observed 56 process calls against a limit of 40 while durable accounting remained 8.

issues.claim: Repair performance reverification associates baselines by slice position rather than target identity.
issues.title: Repair reverification can use the wrong target baseline
issues.reason: Reordered baseline records alter comparisons because target identity is not checked before indexed access.

issues.claim: The performance evidence API fails when its advertised URL omits the limit parameter because zero reaches pagination and is rejected.
issues.title: Default performance evidence URL returns an error
issues.reason: Generated links omit limit, the handler forwards zero, and the store rejects zero instead of applying a default.

issues.claim: Persisted repair reverification validation accepts a passing performance record with no target results.
issues.title: Passing repair performance records need no target coverage
issues.reason: A persisted pass can validate without proving that any frozen target was reverified.

issues.claim: A met report-only performance target produces a flow summary rejected as invalid because outcome counts are bounded by required-target count only.
issues.title: Report-only outcomes make flow state invalid
issues.reason: Summary construction counts report outcomes, but validation bounds outcomes by required targets.
